question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Thousand Faces of Night’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Githa Hariharan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Githa Hariharan** is an acclaimed Indian author known for her contributions to contemporary Indian literature.
 
• Her novel, **'The Thousand Faces of Night'**, was published in **1992**.
 
• The book won the prestigious **Commonwealth Writers' Prize** for Best First Book in 1993.
 
• Githa Hariharan's writing often explores themes of gender, identity, and social issues in India.
 
• 'The Thousand Faces of Night' is a narrative that interweaves the lives of three generations of Indian women, focusing on their struggles and resilience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Writers' Prize**

 
 
• It is an annual award presented by the Commonwealth Foundation.
 
• The prize aims to recognize and promote new voices in fiction from the Commonwealth countries.
 
• There are two categories: Best First Book and Best Book.
 
• Winners are selected from four regions: Africa, Asia, Canada and the Caribbean, and Europe and South Pacific.
 
 
 
• **Githa Hariharan's Other Works**
 
 
• Her notable works include 'The Ghosts of Vasu Master', 'When Dreams Travel', 'In Times of Siege', and 'Fugitive Histories'.
 
• Her writing spans across novels, short stories, essays, and articles.
 
• Hariharan's work often critiques societal norms and challenges the status quo.
 
 
 
• **Indian Women's Literature**
 
 
• It encompasses a wide range of themes including social issues, gender roles, and cultural identity.
 
• Prominent authors in this genre include Arundhati Roy, Kiran Desai, and Jhumpa Lahiri.
 
• Indian women's literature has gained international recognition for its depth and diversity.
 
 
 
• **Impact of 'The Thousand Faces of Night'**
 
 
• The novel has been praised for its rich narrative style and its portrayal of women's inner lives.
 
• It has been included in various academic curricula to study gender and post-colonial literature.
 
• The book remains an important work for understanding contemporary Indian society and women's issues.
